tau.issue: The body is described only through the docstring, and the docstring formula leaves symbols unintroduced: d is never identified as the Ruzsa distance, η is not said to be p.η, and the measures are not stated (d[X₁;μ₁ # X₂;μ₂] + p.η·d[p.X₀₁; volume # X₁; μ₁] + p.η·d[p.X₀₂; volume # X₂; μ₂]).
